verdict.rationale: The pack documents Steel's API endpoints, an OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and integrations with third-party agent SDKs such as Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Vercel AI SDK. None of these evidence an official Steel-published SDK library. An OpenAPI spec and third-party SDK integrations are building blocks or adjacent features, not official SDKs, so this applicable axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
